title: Unforced blow-up near the forced one
plain: Show the known forced Navier–Stokes blow-up can be made to work with forcing that decays to zero at the blow-up time.
math: Prove there exist smooth $u_0$ and $f\in L^1_tL^2_x\cap C^\infty$ with $\|f(t)\|_{L^2}\to0$ as $t\to T^-$ such that the forced 3D NS solution blows up at $T$.
